title: Incorrect Event Date Display in Widget
body:
The widget does not correctly update the event date. I have an event scheduled for today, but the widget still displays “tomorrow.” Interestingly, changing the event date to tomorrow does not make any difference—the widget continues to show “tomorrow.” Adding a new event also does not trigger an update.

It seems that the widget is not refreshing event date information properly. I hope this issue will be fixed, as the feature itself is very useful.
author: Monenon

title: Better write it down on paper too
body:
It’s usable, just a standard calendar app. I can see that Google has put a lot of effort into flashy features, like the whole range of colors, but sometimes the basic functionality fails. For example, when adding an event, there are errors where the wrong day is selected — instead of the day I have highlighted, it switches to Monday.

The iPhone widget is not very useful and has some bugs as well. For example, events scheduled for later today are sometimes shown as if they were planned for the next day, which can be quite confusing. The widget only shows the next upcoming event and there is no option to scroll through the day or see other events. As a result, you have to open the calendar app every time.
